ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the image is “The Soil Food Web”. On the right side there is a blue bird, labeled nearby as “Birds”. To the slightly middle-left position of the bird there is an arthropod illustration labeled “Arthropods Predators”, and there is a food web arrow pointing to the bird. Reasoning: The question asks what birds eat in order to obtain energy. In a food web, arrows indicate that energy flows from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it, so the source of the arrow pointing to Birds is the object that the bird eats. The arrow comes from arthropods, so birds eat arthropods.
